seo.title: CT Prime Community | Learn to plan your crypto trades
seo.description: A free Filipino crypto trading community on Discord. Beginner lessons, live market screening, and traders who plan before they click buy.

hero.sub: CT Prime is a free Discord community where Filipino traders learn the basics, screen the market together, and write a plan before every trade.

inside.title: What happens inside
inside.sub: Pick a channel to see what it is for.

channels.name: beginner-lessons
channels.title: Start from zero
channels.body: Short lessons on the things nobody explains properly: reading a candle, what support and resistance mean, how leverage can wipe an account, and how to size a position.
points: Risk per trade and position size

channels.name: market-screening
channels.title: Screen the market together
channels.body: Members look at the same charts in real time, call out the setups they see, and talk through why a trade makes sense or why it does not.

channels.name: trade-plans
channels.title: Plan it before you take it
channels.body: Write down your entry, stop loss and target before you click buy. Post it, get feedback, and review it after. That habit is the whole point of CT Prime.

channels.name: tambayan
channels.title: Kwentuhan with fellow traders
channels.body: A Filipino community first. Ask the beginner questions, share what you are learning, and trade ideas in English or Taglish without being judged.

planner.title: Plan a trade in ten seconds
planner.sub: This is the habit CT Prime teaches. Set your risk first, then let the numbers tell you how big the trade should be.
planner.note: For learning only. Not financial advice. Crypto is volatile and you can lose money.

ui.dirHint: Long means you profit if price goes up. Short means you profit if it goes down.
ui.lev: That is {v}x your balance, which needs leverage. Consider a wider stop or a smaller risk.
ui.errBalance: Enter your account balance to size the trade.
ui.errRisk: Enter how much of your balance you are willing to lose, for example 1%.
ui.errRiskMax: Risk cannot be more than 100% of your balance.
ui.errEntry: Enter the price you plan to buy or sell at.
ui.errStopLong: For a long trade, the stop loss has to be below your entry of {v}. Move it lower.
ui.errStopShort: For a short trade, the stop loss has to be above your entry of {v}. Move it higher.
ui.errTarget: Enter a take profit price to see your reward.
ui.errTargetLong: For a long trade, the take profit has to be above your entry of {v}.
ui.errTargetShort: For a short trade, the take profit has to be below your entry of {v}.
ui.warnRisk: Risking more than {v}% on one trade can wipe an account fast. Most traders keep it at 1 to 2%.
ui.warnRr: Your target is closer than your stop. You would win less than you risk on this trade.

items.title: Tap Join CT Prime
items.body: It opens our Discord server. Create a free Discord account if you do not have one yet.

items.title: Start in #beginner-lessons
items.body: Go through the basics at your own pace and ask anything in the community channels.

items.title: Bring a plan to the screening
items.body: Post your entry, stop loss and target, and let the community check your thinking.

items.a: Yes. Joining the CT Prime Discord is free.

items.q: I have never traded. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes. Start in #beginner-lessons. The community is built for people learning from zero.

items.q: Do you give buy and sell signals?
items.a: CT Prime focuses on teaching you to plan and screen trades yourself. Nothing shared in the community is financial advice. Always do your own research.
English and Taglish. It is a Filipino community, so ask in whatever feels natural.

items.q: What do I need to start?
items.a: A free Discord account and the willingness to learn. You do not need to deposit money to learn the basics.

cta.title: Tara, trade with a plan.
cta.sub: Learn the basics, screen the market with fellow Filipino traders, and stop guessing.

footer.disclaimer: CT Prime Community is an educational community. Nothing on this site or in the Discord is financial advice. Crypto assets are highly volatile and you may lose some or all of your money. Trade only what you can afford to lose.
